feeds.title: African Americans on the Move Book Club
feeds.description: African Americans on the Move Book Club is a place for book promotion, book reviews, literary source and much more.

feeds.title: Urban Reviews
feeds.description: Urban Reviews is the premier destination for all things relating to African-American Fiction. It's primary focus will be on the promotion of new and upcoming books by Black authors, but Urban Reviews will also include exclusive interviews, online Q&As, tour info, press release info, and industry news as well.

feeds.title: Culture Type
feeds.description: CULTURE TYPE is an essential resource focused on visual art from a Black perspective. The site features coverage of up-and-coming, established, and historic artists, and a dynamic mix of book and exhibition reviews, art news, museum coverage, auction results, and Culture Talks - exclusive interviews with innovative figures in the art world about artistic vision, institutional leadership, and pivotal cultural moments.

feeds.title: BlackPressUSA
feeds.description: BlackPressUSA is a portal for African Americans to find news, politics, sports, entertainment, culture, international affairs, and opinions and analysis. Check out this site to know more about African Americans books.

feeds.title: Compulsive Reader
feeds.description: Reviews of books by some of the hottest writers working today, exclusive author interviews, literary news and criticism.

feeds.title: cup of tea with that book, please
feeds.description: Welcome to cup of tea with that book please, a blog dedicated to books! Take a browse and find book reviews, related news reports, original writing, and of course tea. What more can a book lover ask for?

feeds.title: Nenitraanna
feeds.description: Hello and thank you for taking the time to come and visit my blog. I have had my blog a little over a year now and I love being a blogger. I love to write, read, and travel and wanted my blog to have all of that and more. When I started my blog it was just about book reviews and nothing else! I wanted my love for reading and writing to come together and I thought reading and reviewing books would be a wonderful way of mixing my passions together.

feeds.title: Black Science Fiction Society Blog
feeds.description: Black Science Fiction Society highlights, celebrates and develops science fiction, speculative fiction, sword and soul, fantasy, horror, movies, games and more.

feeds.title: The Brown Bookshelf Blog
feeds.description: The Brown Bookshelf is an online resource that promotes awareness of African American artists who write and illustrate books for children.

feeds.title: African Book Addict
feeds.description: My name is Darkowaa and I am a Ghanaian-American, currently living where my heart feels most at home, Accra, Ghana. African Book Addict was created mid-2014 and its dedicated to celebrating BLACK literature through book reviews, book chats with fellow readers & writers, book hauls and more.

feeds.title: Brown Girl Reading
feeds.description: Brown Girl Reading blog is for people who are interested in books and the English language. This blog also provides resources on African-American writers, literature, book reviews and much more.

feeds.title: Bookshy
feeds.description: Bookshy is dedicated solely to my love of African literature. The aim is to celebrate, recognise and promote contemporary African literature.

feeds.title: Black & Bookish Blog
feeds.description: Antoinette wanted to get closer to her history and culture, something that can easily slip away when you use the narrative of your oppressors. Black & Bookish was created to celebrate Black literature throughout the African Diaspora, tell the stories of Black people, and grow a global community behind those efforts.

feeds.title: Mocha Girls Read
feeds.description: We are a group of African-American Black women who love to read, want to read more and meet like minded women. The books we read range from fiction, self-help, historical romance, best sellers, good short stories and basically anything we can get our hands on. Mocha Girls Read brings black women in the community together to read great literature, online and in person chit chatting about the monthly selection and a whole lot more.

feeds.title: African American Literature Book Club Blog
feeds.description: AALBC are the largest and most popular website dedicated to African American books and Black literature from around the world. We celebrate Black culture, through books, for readers of all backgrounds to enjoy. Follow this blog to know more about African American Literature Books.

feeds.title: B Oliver
feeds.description: Author Beverly Oliver travels to Honduras, Central America to explore the life of natural healer and creator of the African Bio Mineral Balance Therapeutic System.

feeds.title: K. Alex Walker Blog
feeds.description: I like animals, Star Wars, quirk, and any kind of creative media that deals with people finding love in an otherwise impossible time. I was born and raised in the USVI (St. Thomas); however, my family is from the island of Antigua.

feeds.title: Author Janae Marie
feeds.description: Bringing you the drama from the streets with books by Janae Marie!
